key_findings: Dynamic clamp quantifies graded NaV1.8 and NaV1.9 contributions to excitability in iPSC sensory neurons lacking endogenous NaV1.8/1.9.
A NaV1.8-I1706V-like gating shift lowers threshold and enhances repetitive firing.
